# Arjun Trades (Arjun IFVG)

> Tamil trading community and education by Arjun IFVG — ICT, Smart Money Concepts and the iFVG strategy simplified for beginners.

Arjun IFVG runs a Tamil-language trading community focused on price action, liquidity, the iFVG strategy and trading psychology. The site hosts a free workshop, an elite 1-on-1 mentorship program ("The Red Pill"), and a blog with market breakdowns and lessons.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Overview of Arjun Trades, featured YouTube content and student testimonials.
- [About](/about): About Arjun IFVG — Tamil trader and educator.
- [Workshop](/workshop): Free Tamil trading workshop covering ICT, SMC and iFVG.
- [Ultimate IFVG Arena](/arena): A ₹99 paper trading tournament. One-week league, live head-to-head playoffs on YouTube, and an Apex account for the winner with the activation fee covered by the community's entry fees.
- [The Red Pill](/red-pill): Elite 1-on-1 trading mentorship program.
- [Blueprint](/blueprint): Choose between the Red Pill (lifetime mentorship) and Blue Pill (monthly program).
- [Blog](/blogs): Trading insights, breakdowns and lessons.
- [Contact](/contact): Get in touch with Arjun IFVG.
